title: Optimization of a Solar-Grid Water Supply System with Hydraulic Energy Storage: A Case Study
abstract: arXiv:2611.30019v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Given the high cost of grid-scale batteries, other energy storage approaches are needed for developing and low-income regions. Elevated volumes of water are often more economically feasible energy storage options than batteries in these contexts. This paper presents a dual-framework modeling approach for one such energy storage setup: a solar-grid hybrid water supply system in the arid Afar region of Ethiopia. By utilizing an elevated 1,900 m3 water reservoir as a "hydraulic battery," the system replaces traditional electrochemical storage, significantly reducing capital expenditures. Using Python for high-resolution technical simulation and Xendee for economic optimization, the study shows a 55.1% solar fraction and a 10% Internal Rate of Return (IRR). The results confirm that hybrid systems with hydraulic storage offer a financially viable and reliable solution for water access in energy-constrained regions.

translated_title: 基于水力储能的太阳能-电网供水系统优化：案例研究
translated_abstract: 鉴于电网级电池储能的高昂成本，发展中地区和低收入地区需要其他储能方案。在这些背景下，高位水体往往比电池更具经济可行性的储能选择。本文针对一种此类储能配置提出了双框架建模方法：埃塞俄比亚干旱的阿法尔地区的太阳能-电网混合供水系统。该系统利用一个1900立方米的高位水库作为“水力电池”，取代了传统的电化学储能，显著降低了资本支出。该研究使用Python进行高分辨率技术仿真，并使用Xendee进行经济优化，结果显示太阳能占比达55.1%，内部收益率为10%。研究结果证实，采用水力储能的混合系统为能源受限地区的供水问题提供了财务可行且可靠的解决方案。
tldr: 该论文提出以1900立方米高位水库作为“水力电池”替代电池储能，对埃塞俄比亚阿法尔地区的太阳能-电网混合供水系统进行优化设计，实现55.1%的太阳能占比和10%的内部收益率，证明水力储能混合系统是能源受限地区经济可行且可靠的供水方案。
en_tdlr: This paper demonstrates that using an elevated 1,900 m³ water reservoir as a "hydraulic battery" in a solar-grid hybrid water supply system achieves a 55.1% solar fraction and 10% IRR, proving hydraulic energy storage to be a financially viable alternative to batteries for water supply in energy-constrained regions.
